capabilities.justification: The resolver reads <digest>.pif files from an explicit local store directory, and the CLI reads the chain, sign-off, allow-list, goals and registry files named on its command line. Reads only; every digest is verified before a file is parsed.
The machine-readable report is printed on standard output.

justification: A release gate: reads digest-addressed files from a local store and prints a report. It performs no network access, writes no files, spawns no processes and reads no environment variables.
